thread:
tom_sales: Quick note  Heads-up: pricing is shipping ratecard v3.1 next Tues. Main changes: commit bands (Bronze/Silver/Gold), legacy flat-commit discounts deprecated, and a 60-day migration path for live quotes. Full specs: https://redwood.internal/pricing/ratecard-v3.1

ella_pricing: Summary: Bronze = <$20k/mo (no change), Silver = $20k-$75k (tiered discounts), Gold = >$75k (requires VP approval for >30% discount). Legacy flat-commit customers get automated migration offers; AEs must opt-in to migrate customer during the 60-day window.

priya_dealdesk: New approval flow: Deal Desk continues to approve exceptions. Note: any discount >25% for Gold band or any change to commit duration >12 months requires VP review + Deal Desk sign-off. Please label exceptions with tag #rc-v3-1-exception.

carlos_finance: Finance requests that any migrated deals include a short comment in SFDC: migration_reason + original_ratecard_id. Also confirm billing will be pro-rated for mid-cycle migrations.

jen_salesops: Can we get a CSV of all quotes in Quote object where status IN ("Draft","Pending") and amount_monthly >= 10000? I'll triage and queue for AE outreach. If someone lacks access ping me.

legalbot: Automated check: new standard clause for migrations added. Suggested language: "Customer acknowledges that promotional discounts may be adjusted when migrating between rate card versions; such adjustments will be documented in the applicable order form." Legal will circulate final text.

tom_sales: Ops note  rollout freeze: no ratecard deploys 72 hours before EOD Friday to avoid weekend churn. If we need an emergency patch use the standard incident deploy channel.

ella_pricing: AE playbook snippet (feel free to copy):
``
- For impacted customers, offer the migration package: 1) match existing effective discount for first billing cycle, 2) apply new tiered schedule thereafter, 3) record migration in SFDC.
- Tag deals with #rc-v3-1 and set field "ratecard_version_pending" = v3.1
- For customers declining migration, respect original terms until expiry.
```

priya_dealdesk: Quick ask: Deal Desk needs a proxy list of top 10 at-risk opps by EOD Monday. AEs please flag any that would have >10% delta in TCV under v3.1.

carlos_finance: Confirmed: we can support automatic credit memo for the initial matching cycle. Need approval note in SFDC.

jen_salesops: I'll run the report and post a short CSV in the shared drive: /sales/reports/rc-v3-1-at-risk.csv. Will @mention AE owners in the file.

tom_sales: Action items: 1) AEs  review draft list and flag sensitive customers; 2) Deal Desk  prepare exception workflow; 3) Legal  finalize migration clause; 4) SalesOps  run CSV and share. I'll send a short #sales announcement tomorrow AM.

ella_pricing: One last thing: update CPQ templates and /templates/quotes to include the new band labels before deploy. I can push a PR for the PDF ratecard and changelog entry.

priya_dealdesk: Thanks all  please use the #rc-v3-1 channel for follow-ups and avoid creating parallel threads.

tom_sales: Thanks! Ping me if anything blocks approvals or you need VP review names. :thumbsup:
